table.name: TLGNC_ORDER_ITEM_CONTRACT_ITEM
table.description: Stores the exact relation between order items and corresponding contract item for contracts of type Advance Payment Contracts (type=ZADV)

column.name: ORDER_ITEM_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_order_item. Not required to allow for dummy entries blocking simply the contract item quantity, without any order item.

column.name: SENT_ORDER_ITEM_NO
column.description: Order item number as being sent to SAP in the outgoing interfaces.

column.name: DELIVERED_QUANTITY
column.description: Delivered quantity per order item / contract item entry stored in the TARGET_QUANTITY_UOM_CD units of the SAP contract item.

column.name: DELETED_FLAG
column.description: Indicator if order item / contract item entry has been deleted.
